name: jeyabbalas-skills
description: Jeya Balaji Balasubramanian's agent skills. three-pass — a guided three-pass deep read of academic papers that builds an interactive, printable reading library. handoff — compact a conversation into a portable handoff document for another agent. schemify — turn bespoke data dictionaries into validated, browsable JSON Schema packages. chapterhouse — a guided study of whole academic books, chapter by chapter or section by section, with scaffolded support for difficult books, spaced revision, self-assessment, and a printable study site.
